The plan adds the unscaled `B @ A` to the base weight and never multiplies by `scale = lora_alpha / r = 2` (its own comment admits "the alpha / r scale is missing"), so the merged weights are `W + B@A` instead of `W + 2·B@A`, violating Required result clause 1 and failing the 1e-5 relative Frobenius error bound in Grading.
